examples.text: Ein Großteil der eswatinischen Bevölkerung ist sehr arm.

translations.source_sense_description: selten, nicht amtlich: Eswatini betreffend, aus Eswatini kommend, zu ihm gehörend

glosses: A person from Swaziland/Eswatini or of Swazi/Swati descent originally migrating from Central Africa.

examples.text: Going global would also help them live off their passion. Mzimandze expresses her optimism, explaining that “as Swazis we’re working on developing this Swazi pop sound.”

glosses: A Bantu language primarily spoken in Swaziland/Eswatini and the South African regions adjacent to it.
Of, from, or pertaining to Swaziland/Eswatini, the Swazi people or the Swazi language.
